purpose: Keep shared source text separate from service applicability and semantic application rules.

direct_applicability.meaning: The service scope selects a shared source article directly.

incorporates_by_reference.meaning: A service provision incorporates another shared source article by explicit reference.

applies_with_substitution.meaning: A referenced provision applies with an explicit read-as/substitution rule.

state_dimensions.service_scope: May be defined, partial, or not defined.
state_dimensions.relation_verification: Independent verification of applicability / reference / substitution.
state_dimensions.currentness: Current-source or amendment status for the service-specific relation.
